title: Perpetual pursuit of a soldier is excluded from the chase rule
rationale: Identical rook shuttle as mx-chs-001 but the pursued piece is a soldier, which the adopted rules exclude as a perpetual-chase target (as they exclude kings). The repetition is therefore neutral and claimable only. The Fairy-Stockfish AXF classifier fails this fixture on its own, because Mini Xiangqi soldiers are internally promoted from the start and AXF treats promoted soldiers as chaseable; the fork's promotedSoldiersChaseable property is what excludes them, and this fixture is what holds it in place.
